mentions.name: Zachtronics Solitaire Solver
mentions.description: A solver for Zachtronics solitaire games that lets the player take a picture of the game screen, then determines whether the current deal is solvable and suggests possible next moves.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am building a solitaire solver for Zachtronic Solitaire. Especially the last one. It should allow you to take a pic of the screen and tell you if it's solvable and what the next moves could be.
